correctness.rationale: For a positive continuous P-periodic exogenous three-person share δ(t), averaging derivative of logit y proves ⟨δ⟩−1/3=⟨δ(2x−1)^2⟩ on every interior periodic orbit. Strict positivity gives mean>1/3 for nonconstant δ, and integrated inequality/per-period negative drift yields extinction for mean<1/3 and also equality with nonconstant δ. For δ≡1/3 the logit derivative −(1/2)tanh²(y/2) yields the claimed one-sided semistability. For δ=1/3+μ+η cosωt, reflection and ODE uniqueness give the phase-zero self-reflecting fold and reciprocal multipliers. Analytic IFT and quadratic expansion yield μ*(η)=3η²/(32ω²)+Oω(η⁴). Outside the fold neighborhood the return displacement stays negative; inside, D_ss<0, hence exactly 0/1/2 periodic interior trajectories and the prescribed basins. Applies only for fixed ω>0, sufficiently small |η|,|μ| and positive share, not large or slowly varying regimes.
